factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A Investment Properties section attributes value growth to 'operating fundamentals... alongside strong ownership housing developments in select countries' with specific mention of Denmark.

factual_claims.claim: The year-end investment property value was SEK 324,429 million, down from SEK 335,422 million because of disposals and currency translation effects.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Key Figures and MD&A Investment Properties show fair value of investment properties SEK 324,429m (2025) vs 335,422m (2024). MD&A explains decline due to disposals and currency effects.

factual_claims.claim: Privatisation sales reached SEK 10,664 million, with 2,466 units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: 2025 in Brief section states 'Privatisation sales of SEK 10,664 million; 2,466 residential units sold at a 28.9% premium to book value.'

factual_claims.claim: Realised gains from property disposals rose to SEK 2,207 million from SEK 1,687 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A Realised Gains/Losses: 'Realised gains from divestment of properties were SEK 682 (364) million for the quarter... During the year, portfolio sales... generating estimated net proceeds of SEK 2,945 million... Realised gains from divestment of properties increased to SEK 2,207 million (1,687)'

factual_claims.claim: Profit before tax increased to SEK 16,012 million from SEK 10,403 million, driven by higher property-related earnings, fair value gains and a SEK 3,996 million foreign exchange gain compared with a SEK 2,038 million loss in 2024.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows profit before tax SEK 16,012m (2025) vs 10,403m (2024). MD&A Profit/loss explains drivers including 'fair value adjustment of investment properties [SEK 9,498m]' and 'Foreign exchange gains/losses 3,996 -2,038'.

factual_claims.claim: However, the Group recorded a SEK 3,707 million goodwill impairment, primarily because higher discount rates reduced recoverable values for Akelius-related cash-generating units.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows goodwill impairment of SEK 3,707m. MD&A Goodwill Impairment details 'As a result of the impairment test performed, management identified goodwill impairment of SEK 3,707 million... The WACC applied in the impairment test increased 110-150 bps... The primary driver of the increase in WACC was a rise in levered betas.'

factual_claims.claim: Despite this charge, profit for the year rose to SEK 13,056 million from SEK 7,621 million.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Consolidated Statement of Comprehensive Income shows profit for the period SEK 13,056m (2025) vs 7,621m (2024).

factual_claims.claim: The balance sheet strengthened through disposals and debt reduction.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A Funding section notes 'Further deleveraging was achieved through the deployment of cash proceeds from the privatisation programme to reduce outstanding debt.' Financial statements show improved leverage ratios.

factual_claims.claim: Net LTV improved to 52.2% from 56.4%, net debt to total assets fell to 48.0% from 51.0%, and ICR increased to 2.0x from 1.9x.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Alternative Performance Measures section provides these exact figures: 'Net LTV, % 52.2 56.4', 'Net debt/Total assets, % 48.0 51.0', 'ICR 2.0 1.9'.

factual_claims.claim: Heimstaden Bostad completed approximately SEK 59.5 billion of financing transactions, while Heimstaden executed liability-management issues in euros and Swedish kronor.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: MD&A Funding: 'For subsidiary Heimstaden Bostad, financing markets remained strong, with SEK 44,900 million of asset-backed financing... Heimstaden, issued SEK 750 million senior unsecured floating rate notes as well as EUR 430 million and EUR 400 million senior unsecured fixed rate notes...'

factual_claims.claim: No preference-share dividend is proposed.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Proposed Appropriation of Accumulated Profit section states 'It is proposed that the funds at the disposal of the Annual General Meeting of SEK 19,546,645,879 is to be carried forward. No dividend shall be paid to any of the Share Classes.'

factual_claims.claim: A post-year-end Kojamo transaction is expected to reduce Heimstaden's ownership below 20% and may result in an accounting loss of approximately SEK 3 billion.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Events After the Reporting Period section: 'Subsequent to the balance sheet date, Kojamo Oyj announced the acquisition of a housing portfolio to be settled by issuing new shares. Following completion, Heimstaden's ownership in Kojamo will decrease below 20%, resulting in the investment being derecognised... A one-off accounting loss of approximately SEK 3 billion is anticipated.'
